reserves.name: Circle USDC held in xReserve smart contract

reserveReview.rationale: Circle documents xReserve as a Circle-deployed smart contract that holds USDC to back partner-chain stablecoins 1:1. Circle's product page identifies Movement as an xReserve partner, while Movement identifies USDCx as its USDC-backed stablecoin. The direct reserve exposure is therefore Circle USDC held in xReserve.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Circle xReserve issuer documentation for one-to-one USDC backing
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No direct reserve asset remains unidentified in the documented 1:1 xReserve model.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Circle documents the on-chain xReserve custody and 1:1 backing model but the reviewed source does not state legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms for the reserve contract.
